verdicts.rule: A bolometer's channel geometry and sightline is radiation_measurement_diagnostics, the family that owns bolometry; plasma_measurement_diagnostics holds only an instrument no specific family owns.
An antenna or launcher and the refractive index it launches are auxiliary_heating; a wave field inside the plasma and its absorbed power density are waves.
The plasma current is a global state of the plasma, core_plasma_physics; a profile or constraint that states the field's shape is equilibrium.
A spectrometer's line-of-sight emission resolved in wavelength is spectroscopy; a bolometric power, a bremsstrahlung filter band or a camera image is radiation_measurement_diagnostics.
The same quantity resolved in the scrape-off layer, the pedestal or an edge profile is edge_plasma_physics; only the core resolution is core_plasma_physics.
Atomic and molecular reference data is computational_workflow; general is for a physical quantity with no single subject, not for a reference-data service.
A quantity whose subject is knowable takes the subject's own domain; general is a last resort, not a default for a core-plasma quantity.
A charge-exchange channel's ion concentration and charge state are spectroscopy; the charge_exchange IDS is a spectroscopic diagnostic.
Radiated power measured by bolometry is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; a global energy-balance scalar is core_plasma_physics; a flux or diffusivity is transport.
A visible spectrometer's isotope density ratio and hot-neutral velocity are spectroscopy; the emissive channel is a spectroscopic diagnostic, whatever plasma region it observes.
Nuclear power deposited in a wall unit is neutronics; the wall-surface erosion and retention that plasma_wall_interactions owns is a different quantity.
The neutron power and escaping flux in a breeding blanket are neutronics; the blanket's structure is structural_components.
A ferritic field-shaping object is magnetic_field_systems; equilibrium owns the field and its surfaces, and structural_components the load-bearing structure.
An antenna module's mechanical position is auxiliary_heating; electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics owns a probe that transmits a wave and measures its phase, not the launcher's own hardware.
The part of the current driven by fusion reactions and its efficiency is current_drive, even when stored beside the plasma current in a summary product.
A quantity in the SOL or pedestal region is edge_plasma_physics; only a core resolution is core_plasma_physics.
A measured or reconstructed line-density constraint on the equilibrium is equilibrium; it is an equilibrium constraint, not a wave diagnostic or an assembled data product.
Electron cyclotron emission is radiated power the plasma emits, so its position correction is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; a probe that transmits a wave is electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics.
A fitted pedestal position is a property of the pedestal region, so it is edge_plasma_physics; the flux-surface geometry it is expressed in stays equilibrium.
A normalised flux coordinate along a ray path is a flux-surface mapping, so it is equilibrium; a probe that transmits a wave is electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics.
A reference major radius defining B0 is both a coordinate of the equilibrium coordinate system and a property of the toroidal field; precedence puts equilibrium first and settles the overlap.
A gap-direction angle used as a position-control reference is plasma_control; the achieved equilibrium it targets is equilibrium.
A normalised flux coordinate along a wave-code ray is both a flux-surface mapping and a quantity the wave code computes; precedence puts equilibrium first and settles the overlap.
Orbit frequency of a suprathermal distribution is fast_particles; the thermal bulk is core_plasma_physics.
A source term with a distribution source in the distribution_sources IDS is fast_particles; a flux or diffusivity is transport.
A pellet's own atom inventory is fueling; the plasma density it produces is core_plasma_physics.
The outline geometry of a flux-loop reconstruction is equilibrium; the coils' signals are magnetic_field_diagnostics.
A passive loop element's geometry is magnetic_field_systems; it is a machine component, not a computational geometry definition.
A shear Alfven continuum in a linear MHD stability analysis is magnetohydrodynamics; a gyrokinetic eigenmode is gyrokinetics.
A sensor attachment-point coordinate is the mechanical state of a component, so it is mechanical_measurement_diagnostics; machine_operations owns scheduling, not hardware geometry.
The neutron emission rate and its measurement are neutronics; the plasma's energy state is core_plasma_physics.
An MSE channel's detector geometry is spectroscopy; the motional Stark effect on the emitted light is a spectroscopic measurement, not neutronics or a magnetic sensor.
A neutron detector's aperture geometry is neutronics; particle_measurement_diagnostics owns a scattering or particle-counting instrument.
An MSE channel's detector geometry is spectroscopy (mse/*); neutronics owns a neutron detection or activation quantity.
A barometry gauge's gas pressure is mechanical_measurement_diagnostics; particle_measurement_diagnostics owns a scattering or particle-counting instrument.
A Langmuir probe's ion saturation current is particle_measurement_diagnostics; plasma_measurement_diagnostics holds only an instrument no family owns.
The current-centre vertical velocity is a global equilibrium quantity; the command that aims the control loop is plasma_control.
A global current-centre velocity is an equilibrium state; plasma_control owns the control response, and magnetohydrodynamics a coherent mode.
The stray field at the plasma position during breakdown is a start-up physics quantity, so it is plasma_initiation; the coils that produce it are magnetic_field_systems.
A barometry gauge's position is mechanical_measurement_diagnostics; computational_workflow owns geometry definitions and tooling, not instrument hardware.
An ECE channel position is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; an ECE diagnostic records emitted cyclotron radiation rather than transmitting a probe wave.
An ECE channel position is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; the flux surface it is expressed against is equilibrium.
A barometry gauge's position is mechanical_measurement_diagnostics; plasma_measurement_diagnostics owns a plasma-parameter instrument.
A neutron detector's aperture width is neutronics; plasma_measurement_diagnostics holds only an instrument no family owns.

A neutron detector's aperture geometry is neutronics and, being a particle counter, also particle_measurement_diagnostics; neutronics owns the neutron-detection family, so the label follows the family.
A charge-exchange channel's optical cone diameter is spectroscopy (charge_exchange/*); plasma_measurement_diagnostics holds only an instrument no family owns.
A divertor target's own extent is divertor_physics; the erosion of its surface is plasma_wall_interactions.
An edge-transport model's flux-limiter coordinate is transport; the model's own quantity in machine coordinates is not gyrokinetics, and a wall surface property is plasma_wall_interactions.
A disruption halo-current wall point is part of the disruption evolution, so it is magnetohydrodynamics; plasma_wall_interactions owns the surface's erosion and retention.
An infrared camera's target-image coordinate is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; the wall surface's own response is plasma_wall_interactions.
An edge-transport model's flux-limiter coordinate is transport; a surface property is plasma_wall_interactions.
A passive conductor loop's poloidal geometry is magnetic_field_systems; structural_components owns the load-bearing structure that supports a magnet.
A plasma_transport model's neutral parallel velocity is transport; gyrokinetics owns the gyrokinetic model's own coordinates.
An EC launcher beam's phase-front curvature is a launcher hardware quantity, so it is auxiliary_heating; a wave field inside the plasma is waves.
A Thomson-scattering laser end point is particle_measurement_diagnostics (thomson_scattering/*); electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics owns a probe that transmits a wave to measure its propagation.
An ECE beam's parallel refractive index is a wave-field quantity propagating in the plasma, so it is waves; a probe instrument is electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics.
Atomic and molecular reference data is computational_workflow; general is for a physical quantity with no single subject, and data_management for an assembled data product.
A density constraint stored under equilibrium/time_slice/constraints is a constraint on the equilibrium, so it is equilibrium even though the quantity it constrains is a core-plasma density.
A line-density constraint stored under equilibrium/time_slice/constraints is a constraint on the equilibrium; the interferometer that measured it is electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics.
A launcher's own launched refractive index and reference-point geometry are auxiliary_heating; current_drive owns the current the launch drives, not the launcher.
An interferometer's electron line density is electromagnetic_wave_diagnostics; the interferometer IDS is the wave-probe family.
Power radiated as an integral over the plasma is radiation_measurement_diagnostics; a bolometer's own quantity is the family's, not core_plasma_physics.
A global loss-power scalar is a core energy-balance quantity, so it is core_plasma_physics; a flux or diffusivity is transport, and an edge resolution is edge_plasma_physics.
A disruption's radial profile is part of the MHD instability evolution, so it is magnetohydrodynamics; equilibrium owns the pre-disruption equilibrium.
